name: Stain Interstage — Trim (LF)
intent: Between-coat interstage for stain/sealer/clear apply on LF trim substrates. Fires between every coat pair via scenario.dynamic_coats.interstage (engine extension 2026-05-12). Four operations: inspect the cured coat, sand between coats, patch any defects revealed by the coat, dust-wipe before the next.
doctrine: Universal LF stain interstage. Used by all Group A (LF trim) stain scenarios via dynamic_coats.interstage. Replaces inline TSK_BETWEEN_COAT_SAND_LF / TSK_SAND_SEALER_LF / TSK_SAND_CLEAR_LF that previously lived inside MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_APPLY_STAIN/SEALER/CLEAR. Wood putty defects move from prep to interstage per user direction: defects are revealed after first coat dries, not before, so they belong here.
